qualification.reason: Physical qualification requires an independently reviewed evidence bundle. Generated study inputs, outputs, and review records are archived outside this implementation branch; no physical tolerances are assigned.

matched case settings, compiler, MPI rank count, and source revisions
retained raw profiles with SHA-256 checksums in a reviewed external evidence bundle
observed per-station ux/uy L2 and Linf errors with documented tolerance headroom
